name: Alexander Campos
description: I make small businesses modern. I find where a business quietly loses money — the call nobody answered, the quote that went out four days late, the customer who would have come back — and close those gaps one system at a time. Grounded in six years of regulated finance operations. Reframed is live in production; ForgeFrame is open source.

services.name: The Snapshot
services.description: Free automated diagnostic across all eight parts of a business. No call required.

services.name: The Teardown
services.description: A week of analysis plus a 90-minute working session. Prioritized plan with costs, yours to execute with or without me. Credited against a later build.

services.name: Fix One Thing
services.description: One business part built end to end, integrated, trained, handed over running. Fixed scope and price.

services.name: The Modern Build
services.description: Front door, intake, quoting and follow-up built as one connected system with a single customer record.

services.name: Operator
services.description: Maintenance, monitoring, a monthly operating picture, and standing build hours. Month to month.

projects.name: Reframed
projects.description: Resume analysis platform, live in production. Voice fingerprinting, multi-reader semantic analysis, streaming AI.

projects.name: Orellana Tools
projects.description: A QuickBooks MCP server and bilingual proposal generator for a landscaping business in Woodbridge, VA. Confirm-before-write tools. Demo-stage.

projects.name: Deuce
projects.description: Calibration-first pricing instrument for tennis prediction markets. Paper-mode; the deliverable is a signed forecast ledger, not a profit claim.

entry_point.name: The Snapshot
entry_point.description: Give a website URL, or describe the business. Returns a graded read across the eight parts of a business, money leaks with estimated annual cost, off-site presence (reviews, search visibility, whether an AI assistant would recommend them), local competitors, and what to fix first. No login, no payment. A name and email are required to open the finished report.

free_tools.name: AI Visibility Check
free_tools.description: Asks an AI assistant to recommend businesses in a trade and town, and reports whether the named business appears. No email required.

free_tools.name: The Small Business Web Index
free_tools.description: Aggregate anonymized research on what small business websites actually get wrong, by trade.
